longTitle: The title is too long: at most {max} characters
displayHtmlOnly: Only an html artifact is shown as a page, slides or motion; one written together has no display
tooBig: A version is at most {mb} MB
noVersion: "{title}" has no version {version}; the latest is {latest}
noFile: The content of "{title}" version {version} is gone

preview.cards: Its cards stay in the conversation and say it was deleted when opened

noBatch: This batch of changes has no batchId
afterNotSibling: There is no block {id}, or it is not at that level

suggestion.deleteAlone: A delete suggestion cannot carry another change
suggestion.noBlock: There is no block {id}, or it was deleted
suggestion.beyond: The suggestion is for rev {rev}, but the block is only at rev {now}
suggestion.stale: The block changed since rev {rev}, and is now at rev {now}; the suggestion is stale
suggestion.suggested: A block the user wrote is not changed directly: a suggestion was made〔{id}〕and waits for the user

op.noId: The new block has no id
op.changed: Someone else just changed this block
op.underSelf: A block cannot move under itself
op.splitAtEnd: Someone else just changed this block, so it was split at its end
op.splitOutside: The split position {at} is outside the text ({length} characters)
op.intoSelf: A block cannot merge into itself

badBlockType: A block's type can only be {types}
otherArtifact: This batch of changes ({batch}) belongs to another artifact
notBlocks: “{title}” is a whole web page, not changed block by block: hand in a new version
notHtml: “{title}” is written together and takes no new version: change it block by block (artifact_block_create, artifact_block_update)

check.refused: {n} parts of the page cannot show in the sandbox; fix them and hand it in again:
check.more: {n} more, listed once these are fixed
check.script: Line {line} loads a script from {url}: write it in the page, or load it from {hosts}
check.style: Line {line} loads styles from {url}: write them in the page, or load them from {hosts}
check.font: Line {line} loads a font from {url}: inline it as data:, or load it from {hosts}
check.inline: Line {line} loads a picture or media from {url}: the page loads none from outside, inline it as data:
check.link: Line {line} connects to {url}: only {hosts} can be connected to
check.form: Line {line} submits a form to {url}: the page cannot submit forms, handle it in a script
check.refresh: Line {line} has a <meta http-equiv="refresh"> that takes the page away: remove it
check.base: Line {line} has a <base href>: remove it and write addresses in full
check.frame: Line {line}, <{tag}>: a page cannot hold another page

edit.empty: No words are selected to change
edit.same: The new words are the same as the old
edit.notFound: "{words}" is not in the page's source: a script may draw it; hand it to a helper
edit.many: "{words}" is in the page {n} times and which one is unclear: select a few more words, or hand it to a helper
edit.crosses: "{words}" crosses differently formatted parts; only words within one can be changed here: select fewer, or hand it to a helper
edit.stale: You are looking at version {version}; the latest is {latest}: change the latest
edit.note: The user changed on the page: "{old}" → "{new}"

notStore: “{title}” is not a structured store artifact and has no entries
defaultDesignSystemOnly: Only a design-system artifact can be set as the farm's standing default
noReference: {type} has no reference chapter named {reference}; available: {available}

entry.notJson: Entry {path} is {kind} and cannot take a JSON merge
entry.noFrom: Copying to {path} requires a source path (from)
entry.noAttachment: Attachment {id} does not exist for entry {path}
entry.tooBig: Entry {path} is too large: at most {kb} KB per entry
entry.tooMany: A store artifact holds at most {max} entries

docs.title: Document
docs.summary: Collaborative block document with tracked suggestions and Markdown export

outline.title: Outline
outline.summary: Single-column infinitely nested tree outline with fold/zoom, checkable tasks, and live human-agent co-editing

slides.title: Slide Deck
slides.summary: 16:9 or 4:3 multi-file deck (deck.json + deck.css + slide HTML) with fragments, presenter view, and PDF print

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: Structured datasets paired with sandboxed charts, field-level provenance inspection, persistent filters, and CSV export

motion.title: Motion Film
motion.summary: Deterministic pure-time motion graphics with frame-accurate scrubbing, chapters, and WebM export to the library

whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
whiteboard.summary: Infinite pan-and-zoom canvas with shapes, containers, orthogonal arrows, tables, SVG sketches, and sealed embeds

design.title: Design Canvas
design.summary: Multi-artboard UI & graphic canvas (.dc.html) with interactive state logic and live property levers

design-system.title: Design System
design-system.summary: Standing light/dark design tokens, typography specimens, and live component previews reusable across visual artifacts
